notes.title: Changelog v1.0.02
notes.content:
Fixed a bug when getting help from Gee in Chapter 4 that jumped into Michelle's scene.
Added better chapter title cards.

notes.title: Office Rivals development update: Chapter 4 has been completed
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thanks for your interest in the visual novel and for adding us to your wishlist! At the moment, I have finished the 4th Chapter of the VN, and there's only one Chapter left to work on.

[list]
[*] Total word count (at the moment): Approx. 96,000 words
[*] Animation: Approx. 30 h-animations, consisting of 700 components.
[*] Art: Over 400 CGs
[/list]

It's been a long road and I'm truly excited to reach the finish line of Nanako's story! Office Rivals will also participate in the upcoming Visual Novel Fest, please wish me luck! I hope this VN will be visible to more VN players especially fans of wholesome doujinshi and webtoons, as these are the influences that Office Rivals carries on its sleeves!

Please try out the demo, and if you have done so, I hope you look forward to more!

Stay tuned!
